ideas.title: Pomodoro timer
ideas.description: A pixel pomodoro timer: 25-minute work and 5-minute break modes, start/pause/reset buttons and a big countdown.

ideas.title: Pixel pet
ideas.description: A pixel virtual pet: a CSS-drawn creature with hunger, happiness and energy bars; Feed, Play and Sleep buttons change the bars, and its mood text updates.

ideas.title: Palette generator
ideas.description: A pixel color palette generator: show 5 color swatches with their hex codes, a Generate button for a new harmonious palette, and a lock toggle on each swatch to keep it.
